body: EPIC anime key-art splash illustration, dynamic low-angle hero shot of a young female skater with a curly dark afro in a green headband, warm brown skin, gold hoop earrings, wearing an oversized acid-lime tech-jacket over a hot-pink crop top, black leggings with an orange stripe, chunky lime-and-orange sneakers -- caught mid-air in an explosive skateboard trick, one arm thrown back for balance, board flipping beneath her feet with a rainbow holographic sheen, intense determined expression. Backdrop is a dense neon-signage city canyon at night, towering skyscrapers wrapped in glowing magenta, cyan, and lime signage, wet reflective ground throwing back the neon glow, dramatic speed-lines and light streaks radiating from the impact point, small bright spark/shine burst accents like a comic-book 'shing' sound effect frozen in the air. Bold thick black anime linework, vibrant neon rim-light outlining her whole silhouette, high-contrast dynamic lighting, poster composition, no text, no logo, no watermark.
